introHtml: Scrub badge ID holders are designed for healthcare environments where durability and easy cleaning matter. These holders resist daily wear from disinfectants and frequent handling, making them a practical choice for hospitals and clinics. Choose from vinyl pouches with hang holes or nylon neck wallets that keep IDs secure during long shifts. Add your logo or department colors to reinforce team identity while maintaining a professional, sanitary appearance.
